deskSetHelpNoMatchText: No topic matches “{query}”. Try another word.

@deskSetHelpNoMatchText.description: Help search: nothing matches what the user typed. Use the language's own quotation marks around {query}.

deskSetHelpFound: {count, plural, one{{count} topic found} other{{count} topics found}}

@deskSetHelpFound.description: Help search: how many topics match, read out by screen readers too, e.g. 'Topics found: 3'.

@deskSetHelpNoMatch.description: Title of the empty state of the Help search.

deskSetHelpReportText: Describe what went wrong; the cleaned app log can go with it, encrypted to the developer.

@deskSetHelpReportText.description: Help page, the Report a problem card: what the report does. 'Save to file' is a button in the report dialog.

@deskSetHelpShowLess.description: Link under an opened Help topic: fold it again.

@deskSetHelpReadMore.description: Link under a Help topic's first lines: open the rest.

deskSetHelpEb1: The sending wallet passes the payment to Epicbox and locks the outputs.

@deskSetHelpEb1.description: Help, 'How a transaction travels' over Epicbox, step 1 of 6.

deskSetHelpEb2: Epicbox delivers it when the receiving wallet is online. That wallet adds its part and signs.

@deskSetHelpEb2.description: Help, 'How a transaction travels' over Epicbox, step 2 of 6.

deskSetHelpEb3: The receiving wallet sends it back to Epicbox.

@deskSetHelpEb3.description: Help, 'How a transaction travels' over Epicbox, step 3 of 6.

deskSetHelpEb4: Epicbox passes it back to the sending wallet.

@deskSetHelpEb4.description: Help, 'How a transaction travels' over Epicbox, step 4 of 6.

deskSetHelpSigns: The sending wallet signs too, finishes the transaction and posts it to the network.

@deskSetHelpSigns.description: Help, 'How a transaction travels', step 5 of 6 (over Epicbox and with a file).

deskSetHelpFinal: {count, plural, one{The network puts it in a block. After {count} confirmation it is final.} other{The network puts it in a block. After {count} confirmations it is final.}}

@deskSetHelpFinal.description: Help, 'How a transaction travels', the last step: how many confirmations the wallet waits for.

deskSetHelpFile1: The sending wallet saves a transaction file and locks the outputs. The file goes to the recipient by any means.

@deskSetHelpFile1.description: Help, 'How a transaction travels' with a file, step 1 of 6.

deskSetHelpFile2: The recipient opens it. Their wallet adds its part, signs and saves a response file.

@deskSetHelpFile2.description: Help, 'How a transaction travels' with a file, step 2 of 6.

deskSetHelpFile3: The response file comes back to the sender.

@deskSetHelpFile3.description: Help, 'How a transaction travels' with a file, step 3 of 6.

deskSetHelpFile4: The sender opens the response file under Finalize.

@deskSetHelpFile4.description: Help, 'How a transaction travels' with a file, step 4 of 6. 'Finalize' is the name of the page in the sidebar: use its translation.

@deskSetHelpSender.description: Tag in the 'How a transaction travels' diagram: the sending wallet. One short word.

@deskSetHelpFile.description: Tag in the 'How a transaction travels' diagram: the transaction file in between. One short word.

@deskSetHelpRecipient.description: Tag in the 'How a transaction travels' diagram: the receiving wallet. One short word.

@deskSetHelpNetwork.description: Tag in the 'How a transaction travels' diagram: the Epic Cash network. One short word.

@deskSetHelpTravels.description: Title of the step-by-step diagram on the Help page.

@deskSetHelpOverEpicbox.description: Switch segment of the diagram: the way through the Epicbox server. Short.

@deskSetHelpWithFile.description: Switch segment of the diagram: the way with a transaction file. Short.

@deskSetHelpStep.description: Under the diagram: which step is shown, e.g. 'Step 2 of 6'.

@deskSetHelpSearch.description: Label and screen reader label of the search field on the Help page.

deskSetHelpSearchKeys: Press / to search. Esc clears the search.

@deskSetHelpSearchKeys.description: Help under the Help page's search field: the / key moves to the search, the Esc key clears it. Keep / and Esc as keys.

@deskSetHelpSearchHint.description: Placeholder in the Help search field: three example words a user might search for (the transaction file, confirmations, the recovery phrase). Use the words the app uses.

@deskSetHelpClear.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the x button in the Help search field.

@deskSetHelpTourAgain.description: Button on the Help page: start the first-run guided tour of the app again.

@deskSetHelpTopics.description: Small count at the right of a Help section's head, e.g. '4 topics'.
